baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 is a causative entry verb, word 2 names the definite destination, and word 3 is a causative recognition verb with the entrants as beneficiaries.
baseline_models.mechanism: An outside-to-inside transition is effected for the group, while the destination is made distinguishable to them rather than encountered as an unknown enclosure.

activation_trace.role: The literal crossing into an interior supplies the threshold and makes admission an effected transition rather than self-arrival.
The tree-covered enclosure supplies an inhabitable garden as the specific inside reached by the transition.
Recognition through a distinguishing trace supplies the destination's knowability and the entrants' ability to identify it.

changed_reading.before: A bare promise that the group will go to Paradise.
changed_reading.after: God effects their crossing into a specific garden that is already recognizable to its entrants.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final causative verb at focus word 3 can concern the destination's fragrance or adornment, not only information about it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same act that makes the garden known may act on the garden itself, preparing its sensible character for those being admitted.

activation_trace.role: Literal entry makes the prepared destination something the beneficiaries will encounter directly.
The planted enclosure gives fragrance and adornment a concrete environmental object.
The scenting and beautifying branch lets the causative verb describe preparation of the garden's perceptible quality.

changed_reading.before: God has told them what their destination is.
changed_reading.after: God has made the destination fragrant, adorned, and experientially ready for them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: All three focus roots can organize an inside: entry, a concealed or protective enclosure, and recognition granted to its intended occupants.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garden's concealment is not ignorance for its entrants. It is a protected interior selectively opened and rendered legible to those brought inside.

activation_trace.role: The branch of inwardness and concealed interior supplies a boundary between public exterior and intimate inside.
Covering and concealment make the destination an interior screened from ordinary access.
Protective covering turns enclosure into shelter rather than mere hiddenness.
Granted recognition makes the screened interior legible to its beneficiaries without making it generally exposed.

changed_reading.before: Paradise is an openly identified reward-place.
changed_reading.after: Paradise is a protected interior whose concealment remains transparent to the people admitted into it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The recognition root at focus word 3 also carries a form-distant image of a self that settles, bears, and becomes at ease.
baseline_models.mechanism: The beneficiaries may be made familiar with the garden in the stronger sense of being inwardly acclimated to it, so that entry ends in settled belonging rather than disoriented arrival.

activation_trace.role: The crossing supplies an arrival whose subjective quality can vary between estrangement and ease.
The garden supplies the place in which the entrant can become settled and at home.
The patient, settling self supplies acclimation as an exploratory effect of the causative verb.

changed_reading.before: The entrants know where Paradise is.
changed_reading.after: The entrants are made inwardly familiar with Paradise so arrival feels like settled belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those killed on the path are promised that their deeds will not be lost; the next ayah promises guidance and repair of their inward condition; the focus then promises entry and familiarization. The destination clause becomes the completion of an apparently interrupted route and the fitting of the travelers to its end.

activation_trace.role: An extended traversable path supplies the route on which death appears to interrupt movement.
The possibility of loss supplies the negated failure: their purposive work does not disappear with them.
Gentle direction toward a way supplies continued orientation after the apparent break in the journey.
Making something suitable supplies preparation of the travelers, not only correction of a defect.
Restored ease of condition locates the preparation in the beneficiaries' inward state.
Effected inward crossing functions as the route's completed arrival.
Recognition makes the destination navigable and non-alien at the end of that route.

structural_cues: Ayat 47:4-6 form an uninterrupted future sequence for the same plural group: non-loss, guidance and repair, then admission and familiarization.
The focus begins with a conjunction and retains the preceding divine subject, making process continuity grammatically available.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, negated loss, guidance, inward repair, entry, and recognition; I infer that the guidance continues through death into destination-recognition. A live alternative is that 47:5 and 47:6 list independent benefits rather than successive phases.

changed_reading.before: After death they are simply transported to a known reward.
changed_reading.after: Their interrupted path is actively completed: they are oriented, inwardly fitted, and then brought into a destination they can recognize.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus stands between battlefield exposure and promises of stabilized footing and protective allegiance. The garden's shielding branch therefore becomes a final protected enclosure, not just a pleasant reward.

activation_trace.role: Open conflict and hostility supply the exposed condition from which shelter matters.
Strengthening what might give way supplies stabilization on the near side of final safety.
Protective attachment and support supply the relational agency behind the enclosure.
A covering used for protection turns the garden into the terminal shelter from exposure.
Crossing inward marks the decisive movement from exposed conflict to protected space.

structural_cues: War and binding dominate 47:4; stabilized feet follow in 47:7; 47:11 contrasts having and lacking a protector before 47:12 repeats garden-entry.
The focus's definite enclosure sits at the pivot between combat and the later contrast of protected and unprotected groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conflict, strengthening, protective allegiance, and an enclosure with a shielding branch; I infer a movement from exposure into durable refuge. A live alternative is that the military and garden registers remain separate and the garden is only recompense.

changed_reading.before: The garden is primarily a reward after conflict.
changed_reading.after: The garden is also the final protective interior in which battlefield exposure and instability cease.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayah 47:12 repeats the focus's entry-and-garden frame and immediately opens it into vertical terrain with flowing water beneath. The destination becomes a spatially organized, sustaining habitat rather than a label attached to an afterlife reward.

activation_trace.role: The focus's inward crossing establishes the spatial event later repeated and expanded.
The planted enclosure establishes the destination whose internal ecology is later specified.
The repeated effected entry confirms that the later landscape expands the same threshold event.
The repeated garden root binds the flowing landscape directly to the focus destination.
Continuous fluid motion turns the interior from a static container into an active environment.
The lower spatial relation gives the garden a stable vertical organization.
Watercourses cutting through land provide the sustaining channels of the habitat.

structural_cues: Ayah 47:12 repeats both focus roots for entry and garden before adding a verb of flow, a lower relation, and rivers.
The repeated frame contrasts with the opposing group's consuming and fiery dwelling in the same ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near-verbatim entry-and-garden recurrence followed by underflow; I infer that the later clause spatially unfolds the focus destination. A live alternative is that 47:12 is a separate generic promise with no effect on the earlier act of familiarization.

changed_reading.before: The definite garden is a named but largely abstract destination.
changed_reading.after: The entrants cross into a legible habitat structured by enclosure, elevation, and continuously flowing channels.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first warns of bad action made attractive, then describes the promised garden through distinct tastes, pleasure, purity, and fruit. Against counterfeit beautification, the focus's scenting or adornment branch becomes preparation of a genuinely good environment whose qualities make it recognizable.

activation_trace.role: Displayed attractiveness supplies the nearby counterfeit against which genuine preparation must be distinguished.
The repeated planted enclosure identifies the sensory catalogue as properties of the focus destination.
Direct tasting supplies experiential discrimination rather than second-hand description.
Pleasant sensible quality makes the destination affectively recognizable.
Freedom from admixture supplies authentic purity in contrast to deceptive appearance.
Ripened produce gives the prepared garden a mature, available yield.
Scenting and beautifying lets the focus verb gather the later sensory qualities into an act of preparation.

structural_cues: The contrast runs from beautified bad action in 47:14 directly to the garden's differentiated rivers, tastes, purity, fruits, and forgiveness in 47:15.
The focus's beneficiary phrase permits the preparation to be specifically for the admitted group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive adornment followed by a materially differentiated garden; I infer that the focus's scenting branch names authentic preparation and recognizability. A live alternative is that the final focus verb remains purely cognitive and the sensory catalogue is independent elaboration.

changed_reading.before: The garden is made known by verbal disclosure.
changed_reading.after: The garden is made sensorially distinctive and genuinely beautiful for them, the true counterpart to falsely beautified action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Increased guidance, arrived signs, and knowledge form a curriculum of recognition before the final arrival. The focus can therefore describe an acquired capacity to recognize the promised destination, not merely a one-time announcement of its identity.

activation_trace.role: Repeated path-direction supplies an ongoing orientation process rather than a single disclosure.
Growth and increase make that orientation cumulative.
A perceivable sign supplies anticipatory markers by which what is coming can be recognized.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies the bridge between knowledge and wayfinding.
Trace-based recognition receives the accumulated guidance and signs as its operative means.

structural_cues: Ayah 47:17 explicitly increases guidance for those already guided; 47:18 says the signs have arrived; 47:19 opens with a command to know.
This epistemic sequence occurs after the focus promise but before later examples of recognition by marks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cumulative guidance, arrived signs, and knowledge; I infer that these cultivate the recognition presupposed by the focus. A live alternative is that the signs concern only the Hour and do not mediate recognition of the garden.

changed_reading.before: God identifies Paradise to them at or after entry.
changed_reading.after: God progressively trains their recognition through guidance and signs, so the destination is familiar before its threshold is crossed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root later qualifies speech within a sequence of obedience, truthfulness, and good. This activates a normative layer: the garden may be recognizable because it is the consummation of the good order its entrants already learned to enact.

activation_trace.role: Socially and morally approved conduct supplies a normative sense of what is familiar and fitting.
Making a commitment true in action supplies enacted correspondence rather than verbal recognition alone.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies the ethical direction of that correspondence.
The approved-good branch lets the focus's familiarization resonate with moral fit as well as cognition.
The garden gives that practiced good an eventual environment in which it can be fully inhabited.

structural_cues: Ayah 47:21 places the repeated recognition root between obedience and truthful action and closes by calling that course better for them.
The derivation in 47:21 differs from the focus verb, so the connection is a root-level resonance rather than syntactic equivalence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies approved speech, truthfulness, good, and the repeated root; I infer an ethical continuity between practiced good and a familiar destination. A live alternative is that the later adjective contributes no semantic pressure to the earlier causative verb.

changed_reading.before: Paradise is recognizable because information about it has been supplied.
changed_reading.after: Paradise is recognizable as the fully inhabited form of a good the entrants have already practiced and learned to trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus grants insiders entry into a concealed yet knowable enclosure. Later, locked hearts and hidden secrets culminate in corrupt inward contents being forced outward. The two sequences form an asymmetric boundary pattern: hospitable hiddenness opens to its people, while hostile hiddenness is involuntarily exposed.

activation_trace.role: The heart as an inward center supplies the contrasting human interior.
Closure and hardness make that interior inaccessible even to reflection.
Concealment within supplies the withheld content of the opposing interior.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the forced reversal from inner secrecy to exposure.
The focus's inward and intimate branch supplies the positively opened interior.
Concealment supplies the protected destination whose hiddenness is hospitable rather than obstructive.
Granted recognition lets the intended entrants know the protected interior without violating its shelter.

structural_cues: Ayah 47:29 names concealed rancor, but that root has no packet branch inventory and is used here only as a structural cue.
Ayat 47:24, 47:26, and 47:29 move from locked hearts through secrets to divine extraction; 47:30 then moves to recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a concealed focus enclosure, locked hearts, secrets, and extraction from hiding; I infer a contrast between selective access and forced exposure. A live alternative is that the interior vocabulary describes unrelated moral psychology and should not spatially reshape the garden.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely combines admission with information about a destination.
changed_reading.after: The focus grants a protected interior that opens knowingly to its people, the positive inverse of corrupt interiors that must be broken open and exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayah 47:30 repeats the focus recognition root twice and demonstrates recognition through visible marks and inflected speech. This sharpens the focus from being told about Paradise to being furnished with cues by which the entrants can identify it for themselves.

activation_trace.role: The repeated act of identifying persons from evidence demonstrates the root's diagnostic recognition mechanism in context.
A visible feature indicating an underlying condition supplies one concrete carrier of recognition.
Speech angled toward an implicit sense supplies an audible carrier of recognition.
Disclosure to a knower locates diagnostic recognition within a wider field of knowledge.
The focus causative can now be heard as supplying discriminating cues, not only transmitting a proposition.
The garden is the object whose own marks can make arrival self-confirming.

structural_cues: Ayah 47:30 repeats the recognition root twice with explicit instrumental phrases for a mark and for speech tone.
The context occurrence is branch-resolved through the focus inventory, as permitted for a root shared with the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies same-root recognition by visual and auditory evidence; I infer that the focus causative equips the garden with analogous identifying cues. A live alternative is simple prior acquaintance or assignment of dwellings without any diagnostic process.

changed_reading.before: God has informed them that Paradise is their destination.
changed_reading.after: God has made Paradise self-identifying to them through marks they can recognize, so arrival confirms rather than surprises.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate repair of inward condition and the later testing of patient people and their reports activate the focus branch of a self that settles and bears. Familiarization can be formation of a subject capable of inhabiting the garden, not only transfer of knowledge about a place.

activation_trace.role: Making suitable supplies active fitting of the beneficiary for what follows.
The inner state or concern of the self locates that fitting within the entrant.
Testing that makes condition appear supplies the process through which an entrant's capacity becomes manifest.
Holding the self against panic supplies the durable disposition required by the acclimation reading.
Knowledge of reports and inward condition joins revealed character to eventual familiarity.
The settling, patient self supplies the form-distant but anchored image of inward acclimation.
The garden supplies the environment for which the tested and repaired subject is fitted.

structural_cues: The same beneficiaries move from repaired inward condition in 47:5 to the focus, while 47:31 explicitly joins testing, knowledge, striving, patience, and reports.
The focus branch used here is form-distant from the causative verb, so the activation concerns subject formation rather than a direct lexical replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repair, inward condition, testing, patience, and disclosed character; I infer that these form a self able to settle into the promised environment. A live alternative keeps the focus verb entirely cognitive and treats patience only as a criterion for reward.

changed_reading.before: The place is made familiar to otherwise unchanged entrants.
changed_reading.after: The entrants themselves are repaired, tested, and acclimated until the garden can be inhabited as a fitting home.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a context branch for escorting a bride, a focus branch for conjugal entry, and a focus branch for perfuming or adornment. It remains valid as a cross-domain activation because the guidance verb immediately precedes the anchored entry and preparation verbs. Downstream prose should present it only as nuptial imagery activated by branch convergence, never as the clause's direct or exclusive translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 has a branch of intimate entry, word 2 can supply a screened private enclosure, and word 3 can supply preparation by scent or adornment.

activation_trace.role: The literal escort of a bride supplies a ceremonial movement toward a prepared intimate destination.
The euphemistic intimate-entry branch converts generic arrival into the threshold of union.
Screening and concealment supply privacy for the destination.
Perfuming or adorning supplies ceremonial preparation of the private enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Guidance leads to ordinary admission into a known garden.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sequence resembles a nuptial escort into a screened, perfumed, and prepared place of union.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the entry root's highly material image of returning thirsty animals to water. It remains anchored in focus word 1 and gains visible support from the later garden's rivers, drinking, and irrigation. Downstream prose should call it an ecological analogy for replenishment after ordeal, not a lexical gloss or zoological description of the entrants.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 includes a branch of being brought into watering again, while the destination at word 2 can be dense growing cover.

activation_trace.role: Re-entry into watering to complete a drink supplies restoration rather than a one-time spatial crossing.
Dense and vigorous plant growth supplies the replenished ecology reached by that return.
Repeated land-cutting watercourses make replenishment a pervasive feature of the garden.
Actual taking in of liquid supplies bodily restoration rather than merely visual landscape.
Giving drink until thirst is relieved supplies the restorative endpoint, sharpened by the verse's negative counterexample.

changed_reading.before: Entry is a single crossing into a reward-place.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, entry is a return to complete watering: exhausted travelers are brought into a living system that fully replenishes them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it draws on the entry root's nominal income branch even though the focus grammar plainly remains causative motion. It stays anchored because the surah later joins undiminished work, wages, expenditure, and the focus entry verb. Downstream prose should retain it only as an economic reversal-image: the reward does not merely enter their possession; they are brought inside the reward.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 can faintly evoke incoming yield while its actual syntax makes the beneficiaries themselves the objects moved inward.

activation_trace.role: Incoming yield supplies the economic image that the focus grammar then reverses spatially.
Loss that deprives a person of right or work supplies the expressly negated deduction from their account.
Payment for work supplies the recompense frame within which entry can be heard as realized return.
Wealth going outward in expenditure supplies the opposite flow to the incoming recompense image.
The garden converts abstract recompense into an environment that can contain the rewarded people.

changed_reading.before: Paradise is a reward transferred to their possession.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the accounting image turns inside out: their work is not docked, and they themselves are entered into its living recompense.

strongest_changes: The immediate sequence changes admission into completion of a path interrupted by death: non-loss leads to guidance, inward repair, recognizable arrival, and entry.
The repeated entry-and-garden frame in 47:12 and the material catalogue in 47:15 turn the destination into a flowing, sensory, prepared habitat.
The same recognition root in 47:30, operating through marks and speech tone, sharpens the focus toward self-confirming recognition rather than bare information.
Locked and exposed interiors preserve an exploratory contrast between a protected interior opened to its people and corrupt interiors forced into disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses threshold, enclosure, and recognizability into one short sequence. Context does not resolve that compression to one sense: it activates navigational, protective, ecological, sensory, ethical, diagnostic, and subject-forming mechanisms, with contained nuptial, rewatering, and economic reversals at the edges.
remaining_uncertainties: The final focus verb may primarily mean prior knowledge, recognition on arrival, assignment of individual places, sensory preparation, or several of these at once.
It remains unclear whether guidance in 47:5 is a post-death route, present formation, or an independent benefit adjacent to admission.
The sheltered-interior and inward-acclimation readings are branch-grounded but depend on reader-supplied cross-domain arrows.
The nuptial, rewatering, and recompense models should remain exploratory images and not be promoted to direct translations.
